source.origin: ultraembedded/core_jpeg (src_v@master, Apache 2.0): jpeg_idct.v + jpeg_idct_ram.v + jpeg_idct_x/transpose/transpose_ram/y.v; the only edits are RTLScout-marked structural fixes that pin the unused multi-block buffer pointers to one block and replicate shared read pointers per RAM bank, plus an RTLScout-marked pass-through wrapper that renames clk_i/rst_i to clk/rst for clock discovery; pristine upstream files: the upstream repository, see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md
source.design: the FULL upstream top incl. its own jpeg_idct_ram input stage -- real ingress ONE 16-bit coefficient/cycle (idx+eob, accept backpressure), pixels streamed out with row-major idx
source.oracle: same 323-block workload as the study jpeg benchmarks (vectors.dat identical; goldens generated by this same upstream RTL)
source.metering: per-block reset, reset-release -> 64th output, summed (matches the study TBs' per-case convention)
source.purpose: the upstream's own ARP under the study flow, for the upstream comparison -- a measurement vehicle, not an agent-optimization benchmark
